description: This file contains the implementation of a static factory class 'DriverFactory' responsible for creating, managing, and quitting web driver instances for browser automation in UI tests. It supports multiple browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Edge) and allows configuration of options like headless mode and timeouts.

classes.name: DriverFactory
classes.description: A static class providing methods to create, access, and dispose of IWebDriver instances for browser automation.

methods.name: DriverFactory.Driver
methods.description: Getter property to access the current IWebDriver instance, throws exception if not initialized.

methods.name: DriverFactory.CreateDriver
methods.description: Initializes the IWebDriver based on configuration settings, with support for multiple browsers and headless mode.

methods.name: DriverFactory.QuitDriver
methods.description: Disposes of the current IWebDriver instance safely.
